item.description: Shell Pilipinas Corporation and the Yanson Group of Bus Companies have renewed their fuel supply agreement for the second half of 2026, extending a partnership that supports bus operations across the country. item.title: XPENG Sets X9, L03 Prices
item.description: XPENG Philippines has announced local prices for the X9 electric MPV and L03 electric SUV coupe ahead of the brand’s official launch on 25 September. item.title: Chevrolet cuts rainy-season service costs
item.description: Chevrolet Philippines is offering a 20-percent discount on preventive maintenance service parts and labor until 31 October 2026 as part of its rainy-season service campaign, featuring 20 percent OFF PMS Parts and Labor plus a complimentary 64-Point Full Vehicle Check-Up.

item.title: GAC scores five stars: Aion UT passes tougher Euro NCAP tests
item.description: GAC Philippines’ Aion UT has earned a five-star rating from the European New Car Assessment Programme under its stricter 2026 testing rules , emerging as one of the first mass-produced Chinese brand models to pass the latest rounds of safety tests.

item.title: Honda rolls out 10 millionth bike
item.description: Honda Philippines Inc. has produced its 10-millionth motorcycle, more than 53 years after it began local assembly in Parañaque.

item.title: Mitsubishi buyers get fuel credits
item.description: Mitsubishi Motors Philippines Corporation is giving fuel support worth up to P50,000 to customers who receive selected vehicles from 8 to 30 September 2026.

item.title: Volvo offers anniversary service package
item.description: Volvo Cars Philippines is offering discounted parts, labor and maintenance services as distributor Hariphil Asia Resources Inc. celebrates its 25th year in the local automotive industry.

item.description: Even if you don't ride motorcycles, it's good to know what a term like "pillion" means so you can at least nod knowingly the next time someone brings it up.

item.title: This Is The Longest Stretch Of US Highway With No Exits, And Of Course It's In Florida
item.description: If you're going to drive this preposterously long stretch of Florida highway, be sure to stop for gas and take a pit stop before you hit the road.

item.title: Costco Is Rationing Oil And Doubling Its Price As Supply Dwindles
item.description: Since motor oil comes from the same barrel as gas and diesel, refineries can make more money refining crude into fuel rather than the motor oil Costco sells.
